failure_modes: Selecting C005/C006 (time_ramp_power 1.0/2.0) would change only the temporal dose schedule, not teacher coordinates or regional attention, and could displace surrounding coordinates without evidence of affinity gain.
Selecting C001/C002/C003 (native_rms_ratio 0.2/0.33/0.5) would alter injection RMS; 0.33 is already the incumbent, and 0.2/0.5 lack evidence of expected affinity advantage.
Treating the landmark-00 rate sign reversals as a spatial gradient or as affinity benefit would misinterpret coordinate contrasts, since recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation; temperatures are immutable and were not proposed.
rationale: D1.2: The offered registered choices are only dose scalars (native_rms_ratio C001-C003) and time-ramp powers (C004-C006). None of them changes teacher coordinates or regional attention; C004 (time_ramp_power 0.0) is already the incumbent value, and C005/C006 would only alter the temporal dose schedule, not the teacher coordinate target. The Analyst's temporal evidence (rate sign reversals in landmark-00 soft mass and local dy, with small whole-window z) is a coordinate-contrast observation, not a spatial gradient and not an affinity benefit; the label semantics state recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior, so no observed affinity labels exist to convert these contrasts into expected affinity gain. D4.1: The incumbent already uses native_rms_ratio 0.33 and time_ramp_power 0.0 with the declared FLOWR endpoint VJP, detached matching and fixed temperatures; the evidence provides no defensible expected advantage for any offered edit over the incumbent, so retaining the incumbent is the correct affinity-first decision. D4.2: A concrete failure response to an unsupported time-conditioned dose edit would be unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the delivery diagnostics show mean delivered over calibration ~0.33 with nonzero steps throughout and no post-window injection, so increasing ramp power or RMS ratio would raise injection RMS without any evidence of affinity benefit, risking strain and validity penalties that are secondary but still evaluated. Because coordinate graph changes alone are not a failure mechanism and no affinity labels are available, no edit is justified.
